4etaQa3_iUFSDWMkTCYTAw.zh: 東歐摩爾多瓦首都基希涅夫(Chisinau)某飯店報告群聚事件,6/22-7/3累計報告59例病例,其中20例住院。當局檢測飯店服務生與備餐區域皆呈陰性,食物感染源仍調查中。
4etaQa3_iUFSDWMkTCYTAw.en: A hotel in the capital, Chișinău, Moldova, reported a cluster event: 59 cases were reported cumulatively from 22 June to 3 July, of which 20 were hospitalized. Authorities tested hotel waiters and food preparation areas, and both tested negative. The food source of infection remains under investigation.
